 1.3.0 Update 


     The way the game is played has changed. Now, to escape, you have to unlock the locked box to get one candle and find the key to unlock the exit door.
     As the gameplay method has been changed, the existing play history has been initialized.
     The remaining objectives are now displayed in the top left corner when the game is paused.
     Changed the sound of footsteps heard when ghosts are walking on wooden objects.
     You can now throw objects and items from the 2nd floor of the mansion to the 1st floor.
     Fixed the door to be completely closed when the player hid in the closet.
     Slightly modified sound in the scene exorcising a ghost.
     Hints are no longer given for item locations that were displayed after death.
     Fixed the issue where the license text displayed at the end of the end credits was displayed incorrectly.


This game is developed and tested by myself, so there may be bugs that I haven't noticed. If you find anything, please post it on the Community Hub and I'll fix it quickly.

After this update, I will invest my time in developing new horror games.
When development progresses to a certain extent, I will come back with news about new horror games.

 1.2.0 Update 


     The existing stage has been deleted and four new levels have been added.
     The game setting menu has been modified.
     The ghost's footprint has been modified to make it more visible.
     From now on, nine additional languages ​​are available on the main menu screen.
     The loading screen has been added.
     The range of sounds that ghosts can hear has been completely readjusted.
     The frequency of horror events has been readjusted as a whole.
     The thunder sound that plays after loading the game has been fixed.
     From now on, each time the number of deaths increases, the location of documents and candles will be visible from a distance to make them easier to find.
     The stage clear screen has been modified.
     The volume of the sound when the player is walking has been changed.
     Candles no longer spawn in hard-to-find locations, always only in drawers or chests.

notes.title: About game release
notes.notes:
[code]This article is written using a translator. sorry for bad english.[/code]

I'll tell you about Deadstep game release.

The game development has already been almost completed in November last year.
But, I'm waiting for document procedures for the application of tax law before sale.

I recently got an EIN (Employer Identification Number) from the US of Internal Revenue Service.
However, if I recently got an EIN, it could take up to 30 days for the new number to be registered in the IRS database.
So the release date of the game is likely to be delayed until February or March if it's too late.

I'm the first time to release the game on Steam, and I'm very sorry that the release is delayed because there are many things that I don't know as I'm developing by myself.

As soon as this document procedure is passed, I'll end all the work and try to release the game as soon as possible.

If the game is released, I have to enlist in a South Korea duty army. (I'll be discharged from the airforce two years later.)

So I can't fix the problems that I found after I enlisted, I have solved many problems that have already happened and I'm going to fix the bugs as hard as possible before enlistment. (No problems are found right now.)

Finally, Deadstep's release price is expected to be $4.99.

Thank you for your interest in my game and for reading this article.

Deadstep 게임 발매에 대하여 안내해 드립니다.

이미 게임은 지난 11월에 거의 완성되어 당장 출시가 가능한 상태이지만, 출시 전 세금법 적용을 위해서 서류 절차를 통과 대기 중입니다.

이 세금법 적용 과정에서 저는 최근 미 국세청에서 EIN(고용주 식별 번호)을 발급받았는데, 최근에 EIN을 발급받은 경우 국세청 데이터베이스에 새 번호가 등록되기까지 최대 30일이 걸릴 수 있다고 하여, 이로 인해 게임 발매일이 기존 1월이 아닌 2월이나, 혹은 많이 늦어지면 3월까지도 미뤄질 수 있을 것 같습니다.

스팀에 게임을 발매하는 것이 처음이기도 하고, 혼자서 개발하다 보니 정신도 없고 잘 모르는 것이 많아서 시행착오가 생기게 되었고 발매가 늦어지게 된 점 정말 죄송합니다.

이 서류 절차가 통과되는 대로 모든 작업을 마무리해서 빠른 시일 내로 게임을 발매할 수 있도록 노력하겠습니다.

게임이 출시되면 조만간에 저는 군대에 입대할 예정입니다.

어쩔 수 없지만 제가 입대를 하게 되면 이후에 새로 발견되는 문제들을 바로 고칠 수 없으므로 지금까지도 이미 발생한 문제들을 많이 해결해 놓았고 입대 전까지 최대한 열심히 버그 픽스를 하고 갈 예정입니다. (딱히 당장 발견되는 큰 문제는 없습니다.)

마지막으로 Deadstep의 출시 가격은 $4.99(5,500원)로 예정되어 있습니다.

읽어주셔서 감사합니다.
